cut: v2 (owner, 18 Oct: 'courts vs satire? It's more satire vs something else') — satire against the powerful, the courts as referee
argument: Denmark's deepfake bill exempts satire, so courts will decide; when the powerful have taken a joke to court since 1831, it is two all, and Denmark is the next match.
syntax: '/' breaks a line, [word] is the pop word; in Japanese a space marks a reveal segment and is never drawn

text.en: Denmark's deepfake bill / exempts satire. / When the powerful go to court / over a joke, who [wins]?
text.fi: Tanskan deepfake-lakiesitys / sallii satiirin. / Kun vallanpitäjät vievät vitsin / oikeuteen, kuka [voittaa]?
text.ja: デンマークの ディープフェイク / 法案は 風刺を 例外とする。 / 権力者が 冗談を 訴えたら、 / 勝つのは [誰]？

captions.source: Bill L 49, tabled 8 Oct 2026 by Culture Minister Zenia Stampe: a new §73a of the Copyright Act, no realistic digital imitation of a person's appearance, voice or movements without consent; satire, parody and political or social criticism stay allowed unless the fake is misinformation that seriously endangers others; target 1 Jan 2027 (Euronews 8 Oct; PPC Land; sn.dk). A bill, not law: the caption and the tag both say so. The question is the station's: every case below is someone powerful against a satire of them.

text.en: 1831, Paris: a king. / The court sided with [the king].
text.ja: 1831年、 パリ： 国王。 / 裁判所は [国王側]に ついた。

captions.source: Paris assize court, 14 Nov 1831: Charles Philipon, publisher of La Caricature, convicted of outrage against the person of King Louis-Philippe over caricatures of him; six months and 2,000 francs (Encyclopædia Universalis; Public Domain Review; Wikipedia 'Pear (caricature)'). The pear strip in the picture is his own defence sketch from that trial.

text.en: 1988: a TV preacher / and a parody ad. / The court sided with [satire].
text.fi: 1988: tv-saarnaaja / ja parodiamainos. / Oikeus asettui / [satiirin] puolelle.
text.ja: 1988年： テレビ伝道師と / パロディ広告。 / 裁判所は [風刺側]に ついた。

captions.source: Hustler Magazine v. Falwell, 485 U.S. 46 (24 Feb 1988): the televangelist Jerry Falwell sued over an ad parody marked 'not to be taken seriously'; the Supreme Court reversed his damages (Cornell LII; FIRE).

text.en: 2024, AI fakes. / Berlin: the government won. / California: [satire] won.
text.fi: 2024, tekoälyväärennökset. / Berliini: hallitus voitti. / Kalifornia: [satiiri] voitti.
text.ja: 2024年、 AIの 偽動画。 / ベルリン： 政府の 勝ち。 / カリフォルニア： [風刺の] 勝ち。

captions.source: Berlin: Landgericht Berlin II, 15 O 579/23 (reported 25 Feb 2024), a preliminary injunction for the German federal government against an art collective's AI-voiced 'chancellor' video, found not clearly recognisable as fake or satire (LTO; netzpolitik.org; FAZ via turi2). California: Kohls v. Bonta, E.D. Cal., 2 Oct 2024, a preliminary injunction against the state's AB 2839 in a suit over an AI parody campaign ad; struck down Aug 2025 (Tech Policy Press; court order).

text.en: Two all since 1831. / Denmark is the next [match].
text.ja: 1831年から 2対2。 / 次の 試合は [デンマーク]。

captions.source: The station's line over its own image. The board is labelled CASES IN THIS FILM: the tally counts the four rulings shown (THE POWERFUL: Paris 1831, Berlin 2024; SATIRE: Washington 1988, California 2024). L 49 is a bill: the tag says so.

stamps.why: rubber stamps on the exhibits: red where the powerful won, green where satire did

post.en: Denmark's deepfake bill exempts satire, so courts will decide what counts. When the powerful take a joke to court, who wins? Paris 1831: the king. Washington 1988: satire. Berlin 2024: the government. California 2024: satire. Two all. #satire #deepfakes #Denmark
post.fi: Tanskan deepfake-lakiesitys sallii satiirin, joten tuomioistuimet päättävät, mikä sitä on. Kun vallanpitäjät vievät vitsin oikeuteen, kuka voittaa? Pariisi 1831: kuningas. Washington 1988: satiiri. Berliini 2024: hallitus. Kalifornia 2024: satiiri. Tasan.
post.ja: デンマークのディープフェイク法案は風刺を例外とする。何が風刺かは裁判所が決める。権力者が冗談を訴えたら、勝つのは誰？パリ1831年は国王。ワシントン1988年は風刺。ベルリン2024年は政府。カリフォルニア2024年は風刺。2対2。
